summary: Conditional reset of the one-time init flag byte_8AFE71, the counterpart to ConditionalInit. First obtains a non-zero status from StructFieldGetter(&dword_8B78A0); only then is the flag consulted. When the flag is set (1), it is cleared to 0 and a further dispatch/getter on dword_8B78A0 runs, whose return value becomes the result. When the flag was already clear, the current flag value is returned. Clearing the flag marks the initialization as not-yet-done so the next ConditionalInit call re-runs its setup. Invoked from main-loop, 2D screen-quad render, options setup, and video-manager enter paths.

operations.description: Call StructFieldGetter(&dword_8B78A0) and store the result in the working value.
Guard: only proceed when the StructFieldGetter result is non-zero.
Load byte_8AFE71 into the low byte of the working value (becomes the fallback return).
Guard: only proceed when byte_8AFE71 is non-zero (init flag still set).
Run the follow-up dispatch/getter on dword_8B78A0 and place its result in the low byte of the working value; the dispatch target (VTableDispatchGetter) is not listed among packet callees.
Return the working value (dispatch result when reset ran, else the prior flag state).
